verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a self-hostable analytics platform, both for the vendor's own product telemetry and for end-user tracking opt-out, so the axis applies. The pack contains no documented telemetry or tracking opt-out: no setting, flag, or consent/do-not-track mechanism. Jitsu Functions can filter events, but that is a developer building block and an adjacent control, not an opt-out feature, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
